channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: How much money do you need to live in France in 2026?
item.description: It's the practical question that people moving to France need to ask themselves - from accommodation to transport, via grocery shopping and childcare, we take a look at the cost of living in France in 2026.

item.title: EXPLAINED: How France's new parcel tax work works
item.description: Since March 1st, 2026, an extra tax of €2 per item will apply to parcels imported from countries outside the European Union, in addition to standard customs duties. Here's how it works and who pays.

item.title: EXPLAINED: Why France's far-left leader is battling accusations of anti-Semitism
item.description: France's hard left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon has denied accusations of anti-Semitism over jokes about the name of Jeffrey Epstein - here's what happened.

item.title: French expression of the day: Brut de décoffrage
item.description: This French expression can be used in multiple contexts from construction to cooking, or to describe someone's personality.

item.title: The best ways to get into Paris from Charles De Gaulle airport
item.description: The RoissyBus shuttle between the French capital and its main airport has now been axed, so here's a look at how to get into Paris from the airport.

item.title: Air France cuts key Middle East flights until March 5th
item.description: Air France said Monday it was extending its suspension of flights to four major destinations in the Middle East until March 5 due to the US-Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: REVEALED: What makes the French proud?
item.description: To outsiders, France may seem to have any number of things to be proud of - from a strong culture of workers' rights to the art of creating really stinky cheeses - but what are the French themselves most proud of?

item.title: 10 everyday French expressions inspired by colours
item.description: French is a very colourful language - sometimes literally. From yellow laughter to having the blue fear, here are some of the language's best colour-related idioms and expressions.

item.title: Macron says France to increase nuclear warheads in plan to protect Europe
item.description: President Emmanuel Macron said on Monday that France will increase the number of its nuclear warheads and cooperate with eight countries to help protect the continent as key NATO ally Washington turns away.

item.title: Americans in France: Details of the healthcare charge and making your voice heard
item.description: From the details of the new 'healthcare charge' and why it is harder for young people raised in France to gain citizenship and how to get involved in French politics, here's our latest newsletter for Americans who either live in France, visit frequently or plan to move here some day.
